problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 6 delivery routes through 6 specialized checkpoints.

Each route consists of a sequence of checkpoint stops represented as pairs (Checkpoint, Processing time),
where each pair specifies the checkpoint where the vehicle must stop and the time required for inspection.
The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which the checkpoints must be visited.

Route details:
* R1 requires the sequence: (C5, 10) → (C3, 6) → (C1, 10) → (C4, 8) → (C6, 6) → (C2, 7)
* R2 requires the sequence: (C5, 3) → (C3, 3) → (C1, 1) → (C4, 6) → (C2, 10) → (C6, 4)
* R3 requires the sequence: (C1, 1) → (C4, 10) → (C6, 3) → (C3, 6) → (C2, 2) → (C5, 7)
* R4 requires the sequence: (C1, 10) → (C4, 8) → (C3, 7) → (C5, 3) → (C2, 1) → (C6, 8)
* R5 requires the sequence: (C3, 2) → (C2, 1) → (C4, 6) → (C1, 1) → (C5, 3) → (C6, 7)
* R6 requires the sequence: (C5, 2) → (C1, 1) → (C3, 9) → (C2, 7) → (C4, 5) → (C6, 1)

Each inspection must proceed without interruption once it begins,
and each checkpoint can only handle one vehicle at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing order of all inspections at the checkpoints
so that the total completion time for all delivery routes is minimized.
